q: Kill 1 Den Watcher, 2 Ursas, 10 Totemics, and 12 Warriors of the Foulweald tribe, and then return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 20 Plague Spreaders in the eastern Raven Hill mausoleum.
Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Bring an Elder Crocolisk Skin to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
Bring 20 Shrunken Heads to Nimboya at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun of Ratchet wants you to collect 10 Theramore Medals and slay Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan and Cannoneer Smythe.
Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.
Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
Kill the druids: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, Mavoris Cloudsbreak; then return to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.
Take your reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Vault of Ironforge.
Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
Bring 8 Crystalized Scales to Collin Mauren in Stormwind.
Bring Razorflank's Medallion to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.
Bring Razorflank's Heart to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.
Escort Willix the Importer out of Razorfen Kraul.
Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
Destroy the Ancient Moonstone Seal at the ancient flame in Ameth'Aran, then return to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.
Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Bring a Webwood Egg to Gilshalan in Aldrassil.
Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.
Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.
Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.
Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.
Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.
Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.
According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.
Paragons of Power: The Augur's Belt
Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.
String 5 Channeler's Heads, then return the Collection of Troll Heads to Exzhal on Yojamba Isle.
Arygos in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring him Imperial Qiraji Armaments and 3 Elementium Ore.
Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
The Alliance Needs More Copper Bars!
Bring 20 copper bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Bring 10 light leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!
Bring 20 linen bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
The Alliance Needs Rainbow Fin Albacore!
Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!
Bring 20 rainbow fin albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!
Bring 20 copper bars to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.
Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
Give Deliana your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
Give Mokvar your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
Give Deliana your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.

Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Gauntlets if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Handguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Handguards if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 1 Nexus Crystal.
Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Gloves of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gloves, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps and 4 Mooncloth.

Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 16 Enchanted Leathers, 5 Essences of Water, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
